NMS 06:00 | MAJOR | PAD85 | rectifier input lost (mains), DC on batteries
NMS 06:00 | CRITICAL | transmission HOM12->PAD85 | fibre/MW path down, no sync

finding.finding: The authoritative snapshots verify grid power failure at Beruwala (S01) and Padukka (S09), and a down backhaul link from Homagama (S08) to Padukka (S09), link L09. No equipment condition is stated.

Resolved faults are S01 and S09 grid-power failures and L09 backhaul failure. S01 and S09 equipment is verified OK. The catalogue provides generator deployments for the power faults and a link repair for L09. C1 and C2 have equipment and generator skills, but neither has backhaul skill; no available crew is listed as able to repair L09. Roads are not reported blocked. G1 is available at DEPOT with 120 minutes of fuel; deployment duration is 10 minutes. No actions are deferred because the evidence does not establish that any action is unsafe or impossible.

questions.question: Can you confirm or assign a backhaul-skilled crew for the L09 link repair? Neither listed crew has backhaul skill, and the resolved fault is still present.

finding.finding: S09 has the greatest approved service weight (critical, 5); S01 and all other services have weight 1. Current evidence indicates S01 and S09 lack grid power, and the L09 path to S09 is down. S09 is therefore affected by both its local power loss and the path outage; its critical weight makes that outage the highest priority. S01 also has a reported mains failure, but its service weight remains standard. No credible evidence supports changing any approved priority.
